sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Kɛwo mli kɛtsɔ SP Flash dɛŋdade GUI nɔ
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI lɛ baagbele kɛ o-firmware lɛ ni akɛwo mli momo.

• Yɛ SP Flash Tool lɛ mli lɛ, halamɔ "Format All + Download" kɛjɛ adeka ni baa shi lɛ mli.

{hint}

Klikimɔ OK nɔ koni okɛ SP Flash Tool lɛ atsu nii ni oje Updata lɛ mli.

support_story_1_headline: Kɛ́ nibii afelɔi tee hiɛ lɛ, akutso lɛ mli bii lɛ teɔ shi.
support_story_1_lead: Otsɔne lɛ he buu kɛjɛ hardware ni efee dioo kɛ tsakemɔi ni efite lɛ ahe.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis jieɔ firmwares heei kpo daa kɛhaa shwɛlɔi tamɔ Y1 (ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔɔ hidden board tsakemɔi tamɔ 6.0, 7.0, kɛ 8.0) ni fiteɔ tsɔnei momoi lɛ dioo. Nɔ ni ehiii fe fɛɛ lɛ, amɛ wɛbsaiti lɛ haaa kɔkɔbɔɔ ko kwraa kɛ hegbɛ ko kwraa kɛya tsutsu nitsumɔ mli tsɔnei ni akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ anɔ koni amɛná hewalɛ kɛjɛ shihilɛ ni mli wa mli. Updata kɛ Community Firmware nitsumɔ lɛ jieɔ nibii lɛ: wɔkɛ ROM fɛɛ ROM ni eho lɛ toɔ, wɔkwɛɔ o-hardware lɛ mli tsakemɔ lɛ nɔ mi, ni wɔhaa o-player lɛ tsuɔ nii shweshweeshwe.
support_story_1_item_1: Shwɛlɔi ni Efite lɛ Yiwalaheremɔ: Shweshweeshwefeemɔ kwɛmɔi haa tsakemɔi heei efiteee hardware momo lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
support_story_1_item_2: Stock ROMs ni ato: Ajie Innioasis nitsumɔhe lɛ tsɔnei lɛ fɛɛ anaabuamɔ.
support_story_1_item_3: Nɔ ni akɛtsuɔ nii: Nibii ni kpɛɔ kɛha macOS, Linux, kɛ Windows fɛɛ.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Nilee: Bod lɛ diɛŋtsɛ naa bɔni afee ni onine ashɛ paketi ni sa nɔ be fɛɛ be.
support_story_2_headline: Google Draivi ni efite bɛ. Susumɔ-nitsumɔ ko bɛ. Fimwɛɛ ni miitsu nii kɛkɛ.
support_story_2_lead: Akutsoŋ nibii ni yɔɔ oya, ni akwɛ mli jogbaŋŋ ni obaanyɛ okɛ ohe afɔ̃ nɔ diɛŋtsɛ.
support_story_2_body: Innioasis sɔftwɛɛ lɛ sɛɛdii tsɔɔ akɛ esa akɛ akwɛ forɔm nɔ kɛha Google Drive links ni efite, Baidu atatu mli nibii ni egbo, kɛ teemɔŋ zip faili ni bɛ nibii ni kpɛɔ. Wɔma nɔ ko ni anyɛɔ akɛ he fɔ̃ɔ nɔ, ni yɔɔ eheyeli ni akɛ SHA-256 anɔkwayeli ni ama nɔ mi, adafitswaa tsakemɔi, kɛ nibii ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ ni akudɔɔ lɛ. O oniatsumɔi lɛ haa nibii ni ajieɔ kɛjɛɔ Intanɛt lɛ nɔ kɛ nibii ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ ni haa enɛ baa mli lɛ hiɔ shi tɛ̃ɛ ŋmɛlɛtswai 24 daa gbi, gbii 365 yɛ afi mli.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Oya, nibii ni ajieɔ kɛjɛɔ mli tɛ̃ɛ ni husu ko bɛ he loo linki ni gboi.
support_story_2_item_2: Tsakemɔ adafitswaa: Na kɔkɔbɔɔ yɛ be mli ni akutsoŋ nibii heei jieɔ loo tsakemɔi baa shi.
support_story_2_item_3: Gbɛtsɔɔmɔ ni Akɛwoɔ Mli: Nibii ni anaa ni yɔɔ faŋŋ lɛ tsɔɔ bo gbɛ yɛ bɔtin fɛɛ bɔtin ni onyɛɔ nɔ lɛ mli.
support_story_2_item_4: Wiemɔi Srɔtoi Akutso: Awieɔ yɛ Blɔfo, Chinese, German, Spanish, French kɛ Japan wiemɔ mli kwraa.
support_story_3_headline: O-Innioasis shwɛlɔ lɛ nyɛmɔi fɛɛ ni agbeleɔ.
support_story_3_lead: Rockbox ni akɛbaa, kusum nitsumɔ gbɛjianɔtoi ni tsiimɔ waaa, kɛ odiophile heyeli.
support_story_3_body: Stock factory tsɔne lɛ shwieɔ nɔ ni o-Y1 loo Y2 hardware lɛ baanyɛ afee lɛ nɔ pɛ. Wɔ akutso lɛ kɛ Rockbox, nitsumɔ gbɛjianɔtoi ni yɔɔ mlɛo, audiophile codec lalamɔ, kɛ saji otii ni afee lɛ ba wala mli. Wɔheɔ hardware henɔi kɛjɛɔ wɔkotoku mli koni wɔkɛka wɔkwɛ, wɔku sɛɛ wɔkwɛ, ni wɔkwɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ mli. Updata ni fiɔ sɛɛ lɛ haa kaai nɛɛ shika tɛ̃ɛ ni ehaa tsɔne ni akɛtsuɔ nii yɛ kusum naa lɛ yaa hiɛ oya.
support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox ni Klikiɔ Shikome: Audiophile lalamɔ kɛ kusum saji ni akɛwoɔ mli yɛ sɛkɛndii fioo komɛi amli.
support_story_3_item_2: Akutsoŋ Fimwɛɛ: Batri mliyaa, UI ni he tse, kɛ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ odio kodɛk yelikɛbuamɔ.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Wɔkaa nibii diɛŋtsɛ wɔkwɛɔ dani wɔjieɔ nɔ ko ni ama lɛ kpo.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% ni aheee nɔ ko, teemɔŋ-klɛŋklɛŋ sɔftwɛɛ ni adafitswaa loo sɛɛnyiɛmɔ bɛ mli.
support_story_4_headline: Ye obua wɔ ni wɔfee nɔ ni Innioasis efeee lɛ.
support_story_4_lead: Akutsoŋ hewalɛ firmware hebuu ni haaa otsɔnei akaje sũ mli.
support_story_4_body: Kɛji hardware nitsumɔhe ko tee amɛ gadget kroko nɔ lɛ, ashiɔ modeli momo lɛ. Innioasis haaa Linux yelikɛbuamɔ ko, tsakemɔi ni yɔɔ faŋŋ, kɛ gbɛ ni yɔɔ mlɛo ni atsɔɔ nɔ anáa kɛji nɔ ko ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ ehiii. Updata lɛ yɛ ejaakɛ esaaa akɛ mɛi ni kɛtsuɔ nii waa lɛ shɛrɛɔ lalatswaa tsɔne ni hi jogbaŋŋ ni yeɔ emuu lɛ amɛshwieɔ. Akutso lɛ mli oniatsumɔi 100% yaa tɛ̃ɛ koni akɛha dɛŋdade nɛɛ agbele aha mɔ fɛɛ mɔ.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Hewalɛ ni ana he odaseyeli lɛ hoɔ kɛji tsɔnei lɛ kpoo akɛ amɛbaabɔi nitsumɔ po.
support_story_4_item_2: Linux Klɛŋklɛŋ-Klas Yelikɛbuamɔ: MediaTek ni kpɛɔ yɛ Linux distros lɛ nɔ lɛ yeɔ ebuaa kwraa.
support_story_4_item_3: Tsakemɔi ni yɔɔ faŋŋ: Nibii ni ajie lɛ kpo lɛ ahe saji fitsofitso koni ole nɔ pɔtɛɛ ni tsakeɔ.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Akutso lɛ Shika: Kɔfi fɛɛ kɔfi haa woji atoohe lɛ gbeleɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baanyɛ ahe nɔ ko.

err_code_user_cancelled: Mɔ ni kɛtsuɔ nii lɛ fo mli
err_code_no_scatter: Scatter faili ko bɛ paketi lɛ mli
err_code_missing_images: Fimwɛɛ mfoniri ni bɛ paketi lɛ mli
err_sp_wrong_model: Shwɛlɔ ni akɛtsa lɛ ji nɔkwɛmɔnɔ ni yɔɔ srɔto fe nɛkɛ paketi nɛɛ otii. Gbalamɔ mli, ni okɛ firmware ni afee aha shwɛmɔ nɛɛ awo mli.
err_sp_timeout: Dɛŋdade lɛ enaaa shwɛlɔ lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ. Ha egbo ni ojie kɛjɛ tsɔne lɛ mli, no sɛɛ lɛ, kɛ́ abi bo lɛ, okɛ USB kpã lɛ afata he.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Shwɛlɔ lɛ wo hewalɛ mra tsɔ. Gbemɔ hewalɛ kwraa, ni okɛtsa nɔ ekoŋŋ.
err_sp_download_fail: Afo niŋmaa lɛ mli. Kwɛmɔ USB kpã kɛ port lɛ kɛ batri lɛ mli charge lɛ, no sɛɛ lɛ kaa ekoŋŋ.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Mɔ ni jieɔ nibii kɛjɛɔ mli lɛ nyɛɛɛ aje shishi. Kaa flash gbɛ kroko lɛ okwɛ.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Anyɛɛɛ akɛ nɔ ni akɛjieɔ nii lɛ amaje tsɔne ni akɛtswaa lala lɛ. Gbemɔ hewalɛ ni okɛtsa nɔ ekoŋŋ.
err_sp_com_port: Dɛŋdade lɛ nyɛɛɛ agbele e-serial port lɛ. Ŋmɛɛ nibii krokomɛi ni tsoɔ lɛ ni okɛtsa nɔ ekoŋŋ.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: USB COM port lɛ nyɛɛɛ agbele (tɔmɔ 1013). Kɛ́ obɔi okɔmpiuta lɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ, ebaajie port ni atswa lɛ. Ofainɛ, je okɔmpiuta lɛ shishi ekoŋŋ ni oka ekoŋŋ.
err_sp_enable_dram: Dɛŋdade lɛ nyɛɛɛ aje shwɛlɔ lɛ kaimɔ shishi. Kɛ paketi ni ama kɛha nɛkɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ nɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ atsu nii.
err_sp_storage_read: Dɛŋdade lɛ nyɛɛɛ akane nɔ ni shwɛlɔ lɛ toɔ lɛ. Kwɛmɔ bɔ ni tsakpaa lɛ yɔɔ ha; ekolɛ tsɔne lɛ yɛ hardware mli tɔmɔ ko.
err_attempt_timeout_title: Nɔ ni akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ haaa hetoo
err_attempt_timeout: Dɛŋdade ni kpɛɔ lɛ etsɔɔɔ hiɛyaa ko yɛ {seconds} sɛkɛndii amli, no hewɔ lɛ akpa mɔdɛŋbɔɔ nɛɛ.
err_connection_failed_desc: Enyɛɛɛ ekɛ shwɛlɔ lɛ ato tsakpaa ni yɔɔ shiŋŋ. Kwɛmɔ akɛ tsɔne lɛ egbo (kɛ pin atsu nii ni okɛnyɛ reset button lɛ nɔ kɛ ehe miihia), jiemɔ USB lɛ kɛjɛ tsɔne lɛ mli, ni okɛtsa nɔ ekoŋŋ kɛ́ abi bo.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Afo flashing mli loo niŋmaa nitsumɔ lɛ yeee omanye. Kwɛmɔ akɛ USB kpã lɛ ewo mli jogbaŋŋ ni batri lɛ mli hewalɛ fa bɔ ni sa, no sɛɛ lɛ kaa ekoŋŋ.
err_mtk_output_stall_title: Etamɔ nɔ ni flash lɛ efo mli
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Flashing dɛŋdade lɛ etsɔɔ line kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛha naagbee {seconds} sɛkɛndii lɛ ni etamɔ nɔ ni eyaaa nɔ eŋmaa firmware lɛ. Ekolɛ flash lɛ egbo. Kɛji akɛ enɛ ji naagbee nɔ yɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔi enyɔ ni akɛ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ tsuɔ nii yɛ gbɛjianɔtoo ko ni baanyɛ aku esɛɛ aba amɛteŋ lɛ mli, loo kɛji akɛ MTKClient pɛ yɔɔ tsɔne nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, je kɔmpiuta lɛ shishi ekoŋŋ ni oka ekoŋŋ.
err_only_mtkclient_title: MTKClient pɛ ji nɔ ni yɔɔ
err_only_mtkclient_desc: MTKClient pɛ ji nɔ ni yɔɔ kɛha nɛkɛ install nɛɛ. Ekolɛ flash lɛ egbo. Ofainɛ, je kɔmpiuta lɛ shishi ekoŋŋ ni oka ekoŋŋ.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Kɔmpiuta nɛɛ baanyɛ ekɛ SP Flash Tool lɛ hu awo mli. Kɛji obaanyɛ lɛ, tsakemɔ kɛya SP Flash Tool lɛ nɔ ni oka ekoŋŋ.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Ekolɛ flash lɛ egbo. Ofainɛ kanemɔ sane ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi nɛɛ ni obɔi kɔmpiuta lɛ ekoŋŋ dani oka ekoŋŋ. Kɛ́ onyɛ OK nɔ lɛ, app lɛ baakpa nitsumɔ koni onyɛ obɔi nitsumɔ ekoŋŋ.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Fimwɛɛ lɛ mli nibii ni gbɛɔ eshwaa loo mfoniri faili ni he hiaa lɛ bɛ. Ofainɛ, gbalamɔ nibii lɛ ekoŋŋ loo halamɔ tsɔne lɛ fɛɛ.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Anyɛɛɛ aje dɛŋdade ni kpɛɔ loo tsɔne kudɔlɔi ni he hiaa lɛ shishi. Ofainɛ kwɛmɔ gbɛjianɔtoo hegbɛi, draiva he gbɛjianɔtoo, loo kɛ aplikeshin lɛ awo mli ekoŋŋ.
err_driver_missing_title: MediaTek USB tsɔne kudɔlɔ he miihia
err_driver_missing_desc: Tɔmɔ nɛɛ baanyɛ aba kɛji akɛ akɛ MediaTek USB tsɔne kudɔlɔ lɛ wooo mli. Klikimɔ Download Drivers lɛ nɔ koni okɛ MediaTek USB draiva lɛ awo mli, ni obɔi okɔmpiuta lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni oka ekoŋŋ.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Fimwɛɛ faili ni ato lɛ bɛ. Halamɔ Halamɔ Software ni okɛma faili ni ajie lɛ ekoŋŋ loo okɛ firmware lɛ ato ekoŋŋ. Enɛ ji maŋ lɛ mli faili naagba, jeee USB tsakpaa sane.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Ku osɛɛ kɛya Halamɔ Software lɛ nɔ koni otswa ekoŋŋ loo okɛ firmware lɛ awo mli.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Halamɔ firmware ni ajie lɛ kpo ni okɛbaaŋɔ ekoŋŋ.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Tɔmɔ ko ni akpaaa gbɛ ba be mli ni akɛwoɔ mli ({detail}). Gbemɔ tsɔne ni akɛtswaa lala lɛ kwraa, ni okɛtsa nɔ ekoŋŋ kɛji abi bo, ni oka ekoŋŋ.
flash_method_confirm: Install gbɛ lɛ tsake kɛtee {method}. Ma nɔ mi akɛ ajie tsɔne ni akɛtswaa lala lɛ kɛjɛ tsɔne lɛ mli ni agbe lɛ, no sɛɛ lɛ nyɛɛ Nɔ ni Nyiɛ Sɛɛ lɛ nɔ.
flash_failover_note: {method} haaa install lɛ aje shishi. Kɛji agbe shwɛmɔ tsɔne lɛ ni ajie kɛjɛ plɔg lɛ mli lɛ, akɛ {other} baatsu nii moŋ.
themepack_card_title: Kɛ 360p Rockbox Yitso lɛ awo mli
themepack_card_desc: Akutsoŋ saji otii fɛfɛji, sɛɛgbɛ nibii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi, kɛ niŋmaa okadii ni afee pɔtɛɛ aha 360p nibii ni ajieɔ lɛ kpo lɛ fata he.
themepack_installed_success: ✓ Akɛ 360p Theme Pack lɛ ewo mli jogbaŋŋ!
themepack_step1_title: Nɔ ni ji 1: Kɛ USB Storage Mode lɛ abɔ he
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Sumɔ o-player lɛ kɛtsɔ Power button lɛ ni ooomɔ nɔ.
2. Kɛ́ Rockbox lɛ bɔi nitsumɔ lɛ, okɛ USB kpã lɛ awo okɔmpiuta lɛ mli.
3. Kɛ́ abi bo yɛ tsɔne ni akɛtswaa lala lɛ nɔ lɛ, maa USB Storage mode lɛ nɔ mi koni tsɔne lɛ ajie ehe kpo akɛ draiva.
themepack_step2_title: Nɔ ni ji enyɔ: Halamɔ Folda fɛɛ Folder ni yɔɔ Player lɛ nɔ lɛ
themepack_step2_desc: Akɛni tsɔnei ni akɛtsuɔ nii (tamɔ macOS) lɛ kɛ dotfiles (tamɔ .rockbox) teeɔ amɛhe hewɔ lɛ, obaanyɛ ohala folda FƐƐ FOLDA loo drive root ni yɔɔ o-player lɛ nɔ lɛ. Wɔbaana loo wɔbaafee .rockbox gbɛtsɔɔmɔ wolo lɛ wɔha bo.
themepack_complete: Akɛ Theme pack lɛ wo mli jogbaŋŋ! Amrɔ nɛɛ obaanyɛ ojie o-player lɛ kɛjɛ mli shweshweeshwe ni ohala saneyitso ko yɛ Rockbox lɛ mli (Shitooi > Saneyitso lɛ He Gbɛjianɔtoi).
themepack_err_not_found: Anyɛɛɛ ana loo aje .rockbox gbɛtsɔɔmɔ shishi yɛ draiva ni ahala lɛ nɔ. Ofainɛ kwɛmɔ akɛ ohala folda ko yɛ o-player lɛ nɔ.
